rules_text.raw: You can add one armor special ability to the target if it’s armor or one shield special ability if it’s a shield. The special ability must have a base price modifier no greater than a +1 enhancement bonus or 4,000 gp.

augmentations.name: Augmented (3rd)
augmentations.raw: If you expend two uses of mythic power, you can add any number of special abilities with a total base price modifier no greater than a +2 enhancement bonus or 15,000 gp.
